visualCharacteristics.purpose: Horizontally scrolling product media gallery (images and an optional video) with previous/next arrows
visualCharacteristics.summary: Image-only media gallery, ~3 square slides visible on desktop, first slide may be a video with a poster image

contentPattern.summary: Gallery of product media slides (1 video with poster + 6 images), image-only, horizontal scroll with arrow
contentPattern.structure: one row per slide; cell 1: image (optionally plus a link or plain-text URL to an .mp4 video, the image becoming the video poster); cell 2 (optional): caption text

reuseGuidance: Use for multi-image product/media galleries where several square slides are visible at once. For full-width single-slide promotional carousels with overlaid text, use the base carousel block.
